title: Natural Orderings of Triangle Centers
summary: Triangle centers are usually studied individually or through special geometric relationships, but little attention has been given to global structure among them. In this paper we introduce several natural ways to order triangle centers, including the isosceles order, vertex order, side order, and trace order. These partial orders compare centers by their relative positions in families of triangles, such as acute triangles with a fixed shortest side.
